_comment: New keys for app/clinician/request-access.tsx — the clinician asking a patient for access to their record (POST /mobile/doctor/consent-requests). Flat dotted keys, 1:1 with consent_requests.fr.json, same {{placeholders}} on both sides. Merge into lib/i18n/locales/*.json. No key here already exists in the opesDoctor namespace; the screen carries English defaultValues until they land. NOTE: no key uses {{count}} — that name triggers i18next pluralization and would need _one/_other variants, so the counters are {{parts}} and {{hours}}.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.title: Ask for access
opesDoctor.consentRequest.subtitle: A patient decides who may open their record
opesDoctor.consentRequest.outboxSubtitle: What your facility has asked for
opesDoctor.consentRequest.idInvalid: Enter the full Health ID — at least {{min}} characters, letters, digits and dashes only. This app cannot search by name.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.noNameSearch: Exact Health ID only. This app cannot look a patient up by name.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.lookupEmptyBod: A patient can only be found by their full Health ID. There is no search by name — that is deliberate.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.notFoundTitle: No patient holds that Health ID
opesDoctor.consentRequest.notFoundBody: Check the full ID with the patient. It cannot be searched for.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.alreadyGranted: This patient has already granted your facility access, so there is nothing to ask for. Open their chart.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.purposeHint: The patient sees this reason. It is also what the access is audited against.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.scopeTitle: What do you need to see?
opesDoctor.consentRequest.scopeHint: Ask for the least you need. A patient who is asked for everything stops reading.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.scopeNone: Choose at least one part of the record to ask for.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.durationHint: Access ends by itself when this runs out. The patient can revoke it sooner.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.justificationH: Optional, and read by the patient. One plain sentence explaining what you need and why.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.justificationP: e.g. I need your allergy list before prescribing today.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.footnote: Nothing is shared until the patient approves. They may refuse, and refusing costs them nothing.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.confirmMessage: {{name}} ({{healthId}}) will be asked to share {{parts}} part(s) of their record with your facility for {{duration}}. They can refuse.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.sentBody: {{name}} has been notified and will see it in their app. Nothing is shared until they approve.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.lapsesIn: If nobody answers, this request lapses in about {{hours}} hours.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.outboxEmptyBod: Requests your facility sends appear here with the patient's answer.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.outboxErrorTit: Your requests could not be loaded
opesDoctor.consentRequest.outboxErrorBod: Nothing has changed. Check your connection and try again.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.withdrawConfir: The patient will no longer be asked. You can raise a new request afterwards.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.withdrawFailed: This request could not be withdrawn.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.pendingBody: Your facility has already asked this patient and is waiting for their answer. They are not asked twice.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.uncertainTitle: We do not know whether the request was sent
opesDoctor.consentRequest.uncertainBody: The connection dropped before the server answered. The patient may already have this request. Check your requests before asking again.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.unavailableTit: This server cannot take access requests yet
opesDoctor.consentRequest.unavailableBod: Nothing was sent and the patient has not been contacted. Ask your administrator when this will be available.
opesDoctor.consentRequest.failedBody: Nothing was sent. Please try again.
